extensions.name: Anikoto
extensions.description: Bundled Anikoto resolver. Tries anikoto.cz, then kotoplay.to if Anikoto is down or has no source. Skip times come from whichever site answers. Quality and sub/dub come from the embed label when it states them. If a title is missing, playback tries the others and keeps your choice.
extensions.author: fampep

extensions.name: Gotaku
extensions.description: Bundled Gotaku resolver. The HLS playlist is unwrapped on device. Variant resolution, codec, and sub/dub are reported when the playlist states them.
extensions.author: fampep

extensions.name: reanime
extensions.description: Bundled reanime.cz resolver. Streams play in the app. The playlist reports resolution and sub or dub when it states them.
extensions.author: fampep

extensions.name: mkissa
extensions.description: Bundled mkissa.to resolver. Tried after reanime. A direct file plays in the app. Iframe hosts are skipped. Resolution is shown when the episode states it.
extensions.author: fampep

extensions.name: kaa
extensions.description: Bundled kaa.lt resolver. Search uses the site catalog. The vidstream playlist plays in the app. Sub or dub follows the episode language.
extensions.author: fampep

extensions.name: animex
extensions.description: Bundled animex.one resolver. Search uses the site catalog. The playlist plays in the app, including the default server. Sub or dub follows the episode language.
extensions.author: fampep

extensions.name: Hello HTTP
extensions.description: Minimal BYO resolve example (template — not a live CDN). Shows optional quality, audio, and qualityRating on protocol 1.1.
extensions.author: fampep
